# PULSE

> Precision User Latency and Stimulus Evaluator: Measure Your Mind. Understand Your Potential. A browser-based cognitive benchmarking suite for measuring human response and working-memory performance.

Canonical website: https://pulse-lab.in

## Public pages

- [PULSE Overview](https://pulse-lab.in/): Overview and research telemetry introduction.
- [About PULSE](https://pulse-lab.in/about): About Pulse Evaluator, purpose, test batteries, and privacy standards.
- [Cognitive Assessments](https://pulse-lab.in/assessments): Available cognitive assessment protocols.
- [Visual Reaction Test](https://pulse-lab.in/reaction-test): Visual reaction and motor response speed assessment.
- [Directional Choice Test](https://pulse-lab.in/direction-test): Directional choice speed and inhibitory control assessment.
- [Colour Recognition Test](https://pulse-lab.in/colour-recognition): Colour recognition and cognitive interference assessment.
- [Block Memory Test](https://pulse-lab.in/block-memory): Spatial working-memory and span assessment.
- [Number Memory Test](https://pulse-lab.in/number-memory): Forward digit span and short-term memory test.
- [Verified Leaderboard](https://pulse-lab.in/leaderboard): Anonymous cohort leaderboard with verified rankings.
- [Performance Guide](https://pulse-lab.in/improve): Evidence-based guide on habits and sleep affecting response times.
- [Research Privacy](https://pulse-lab.in/privacy): Research data ethics and privacy policy.

## Non-public / non-indexed

- [Dataset](https://pulse-lab.in/dataset): Research dataset release page (unindexed).
- [Analytics](https://pulse-lab.in/analytics): Telemetry placeholder (unindexed).
- [Admin](https://pulse-lab.in/admin/): Private administration area (do not index).

## Notes

PULSE uses canonical desktop URLs for its separate mobile experience. The mobile interface is at https://pulse-lab.in/mobile/ and is not listed separately in the sitemap.
